I replied to Tobias in a thread on their #central-random message. I confirmed that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 84 seats and said I wouldn't do anything else with it, since they said no action was needed.

I didn't open #central-team or change their earlier post there, so the wrong figure is still in that channel unless Tobias corrects it. Seat counts aren't finance figures, so repeating 84 in #central-random didn't need anyone's approval.
